docs.title: Long Task Callback
docs.text:
Long Task Callback（LTC）​让​ Agent ​在​长​任务​结束​后​回到​原会话​继续​工作​。​你​可以​让​它​提交​一次​模型​训练​、​测试​或​代码​审查​，​任务​在​后台​执行​。​结束​后​，LTC ​把​结果​位置​送回​会话​，Agent ​读取​日志​和​产物​，​接着​处理​下​一步​。

​开始​使用​ ​了解​架构​

docs.title: 从​一个​任务​开始
docs.text:
​在​ Agent ​会话​中​提交​训练​命令​：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​训练​模型​" -- python train.py --config configs/exp.yaml

LTC ​返回​任务​ ID ​和​日志​路径​。​任务​结束​后​，​原会话​收到​回调​，Agent ​检查​输出​并​执行​回调​中​的​ ACK ​命令​。​第一次​使用​可以​先​按​快速​开始​跑​一个​十秒钟​的​示例​。

docs.title: 选择​入口
docs.text: 你​要​做​的​事​ ​从​这里​开始​ ​运行​训练​、​测试​、​构建​或​数据处理​ ​运行​命令​ ​把​一项​工作​交给​另​一个​ Agent ​启动子​ Agent ​接收​ Slurm、tmux ​中​已有​任务​的​结果​ ​接入​已有​任务​ ​重复使用​一套​审查​或​分析​提示​词​ ​编写​任务​模板​ ​跟踪​训练​、​评估​、​报告​等​多个​阶段​ ​跟踪​多​阶段​目标

docs.title: 接入​你​的​环境
docs.text:
​先看​典型​使用​场景​选择​工作​流程​，​再​通过​ Harness ​支持​情况​确认​接入​方式​和​版本​。

LTC ​支持​ Linux、macOS ​和​ Windows。​按​安装​指南​配置​运行​环境​，​再​选择​你​使用​的​ Agent：Codex CLI、Claude Code、Pi​或​ Codex Desktop。

​快速​开始​使用​正式版​ 0.7.0。Claude ​实时​回调​、Pi ​和​ Desktop ​接入​使用​ 0.7.1 ​预览版​，​各​接入​页​给出​对应​步骤​。

docs.title: 继续​阅读
docs.text: ​架构​概览​介绍​一次​任务​从​提交​到​回调​的​过程​。​命令​速查​方便​随用​随查​，​遇到​运行​问题​时​查看​常见问题​。​模块​说明​、​平台​实现​与​验证​记录​收录​在​开发​资料​。

docs.title: 安装
docs.text: ​准备​ Python 3.9 ​或​更新​版本​、Git，​以及​已经​完成​登录​的​ Agent CLI。LTC ​和​ Agent ​使用​同一个​用户​账号​运行​。

docs.title: 安装​正式版
docs.text:
​以下​命令​安装​ 0.7.0。​虚拟环境​用来​保存​ LTC ​及其​依赖​，​安装​完成​后​保留​这个​目录​。

Linux / macOSWindows PowerShell 
git clone --branch v0.7.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/lz59970062/long-task-wakeup.git
cd long-task-wakeup
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install .
ltc setup --enable --now
ltc --version

git clone --branch v0.7.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/lz59970062/long-task-wakeup.git
Set-Location long-task-wakeup
py -3 -m venv .venv
& .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install .
& .\.venv\Scripts\ltc.exe setup --service windows-task --enable --now
& .\.venv\Scripts\ltc.exe --version

setup ​安装​ Agent ​技能​，​并​配置​后台​协调​器​。​最后​一条​命令​显示​版本号​。Windows ​后续​调用​可以​继续​使用​ .venv\Scripts\ltc.exe ​的​完整​路径​。

docs.title: 选择​运行​环境
docs.text:
环境​ ​任务​由​谁​托管​ ​使用​方式​ Linux ​桌面​或​服务器​ systemd ​用户服务​ ​使用​默认​ setup macOS ​桌面​登录​会话​ launchd ​在​当前​用户​的​终端​中​运行​ setup Windows 10 ​及​更新​版本​ ​计划​任务​与​ Job Object ​保持​该​用户​登录​，​使用​本地​ NTFS ​目录​ Docker、AutoDL ​或​使用​ screen ​的​ Linux GNU screen ​按​下面​的​容器​步骤​配置​

​在​ Debian / Ubuntu ​容器​中​，​先​安装​ screen，​再启动​协调​器​：

sudo apt-get install screen
ltc setup --backend screen --service standalone --now

​容器​内​的​ LTC、Agent、​工作​目录​和​会​话​文件​放在​同一个​运行​环境​中​。​把​ ~/.ltc、Agent ​配置​目录​和​项目​目录​放在​持久​卷里​，​可以​在​重启​后​继续​读取​任务​记录​。​镜像​和​启动​配置​见​容器​部署​资料​。

docs.title: 安装​预览版
docs.text:
0.7.1 ​预览版​包含​ Claude ​实时​回调​、Pi ​接入​和​ Desktop ​启动器​。​使用​一个​新​的​目录​安装​当前​ main：

git clone https://github.com/lz59970062/long-task-wakeup.git ltc-preview
cd ltc-preview
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install .
ltc setup --force --enable --now
ltc --version

Windows ​使用​上面​的​ PowerShell ​安装​方式​，​将​克隆​命令​中​的​ --branch v0.7.0 --depth 1 ​去掉​。

​从​已有​版本升级​时​，​先​处理​完​队列​中​的​任务​和​回调​，​再​安装​新​版本​并​运行​ ltc setup --keep-skill --force --enable --now。​这会​更新​协调​器​并​保留​已有​技能​内容​。

​安装​完成​后​，​进入​第一个​任务​。

docs.title: 架构​概览
docs.text: ​以​快速​开始​中​的​任务​为例​：Agent ​提交​一个​ Python ​命令​，LTC ​保存​它​的​执行​信息​，​在​后台​运行​它​，​再​把​结果​送回​同一个​会话​。

docs.title: 一次​任务​如何​执行
docs.text:
1. Agent ​调用​ ltc run。LTC ​记录​命令​、​工作​目录​、​环境​和​会​话​ ID，​生成​任务​ ID。
  2. ​后台​协调​器​（Daemon）​读取​任务​记录​，​交给​执行​后​端​启动​。
  3. Worker ​执行命令​，​把​标准​输出​和​错误​输出​写入​日志​。
  4. ​命令​退出​后​，Worker ​保存​退出​码​和​结果​，​创建​回调​。
  5. Daemon ​将​回调​送回​原会话​。Agent ​读取​产物​，​执行​ ltc ack，​再​决定​下​一步​工作​。
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Agent ​会话​
    participant L as LTC CLI
    participant D as Daemon
    participant W as Worker
    A->>L: ​提交​命令​
    L->>L: ​保存​任务​记录​与会​话​ ID
    L-->>A: ​返回​任务​ ID ​和​日志​路径​
    D->>W: ​通过​执行​后​端​启动​任务​
    W->>W: ​执行命令​，​保存​日志​与​结果​
    W-->>D: ​创建​回调​
    D-->>A: ​投递​结果​位置​和​任务​状态​
    A->>L: ​读取​结果​后​ ACK

docs.title: 各​组件​负责​什么
docs.text:
组件​ ​工作​ CLI ​接收​ run、agent、done ​等​命令​，​保存​任务​和​回调​记录​ Daemon ​协调​任务​启动​，​处理​恢复​，​投递​回调​ ​执行​后​端​ ​使用​操作系统​的​进程​管理机制​托管​ Worker Worker ​执行​用户​命令​，​记录​日志​、​退出​码​和​结果​ Agent ​适配器​ ​识别​会话​，​构造​子​ Agent ​启动​命令​和​原会话​恢复​命令​ ​存储​ ​保存​任务​、​结果​、​回调​和​ ACK，​供​后续​查询​与​恢复​

Linux ​使用​ systemd ​用户服务​，macOS ​使用​ launchd，Windows ​使用​计划​任务​和​ Job Object。Linux ​和​ macOS ​也​可以​使用​ GNU screen ​后​端​。​每个​任务​在​提交​时​记录​所选后​端​。

​使用​原生​后端​时​，​协调​器​和​任务​由​各自​的​系统​服务​托管​。​协调​器​重启​后​，​会​读取​已有​任务​记录​，​核对​进程​和​结果​，​接着​处理​回调​。

docs.title: 三个​入口​如何​配合
docs.text:
ltc run ​从​一个​命令​开始​，Worker ​负责​运行​它​。ltc agent ​把​任务​描述​交给​一个​新​启动​的​ Agent，​并​保存​它​的​回答​。​这​两种​入口​共用​任务​记录​、​执行​后端​和​回调​流程​。

ltc done ​用于​已经​在​其他​环境中运行​的​任务​。​例如​，​一个​ Slurm ​作业​在​脚本​结束​处​报告​退出​码​，LTC ​随后​把​这次​运行​的​结果​交回​指定​会话​。

docs.title: 到​哪里找​结果
docs.text:
​默认​情况​下​，​任务​文件​保存​在​ ~/.ltc/tasks/<task-id>/。attempt-1.log ​记录​命令​输出​，result.json ​记录​执行​结果​；​提交​命令​和​回调​都​会​给出​对应​路径​。

​回调​ ACK ​记录​ Agent ​已经​收到​并​检查​了​这次​结果​。​需要​跟踪​“​训练​、​评估​、​生成​报告​”​这样​的​完整​流程​时​，​可以​建立​目标​计划​，​逐项​记录​各​阶段​进度​。

​扩展​执行​后端​或​ Agent ​适配器​时​，​参阅​模块​职责​。

docs.title: 快速​开始
docs.text:
​这次​先​运行​一个​十秒钟​的​小​任务​。​完成​后​，​你​会​在​原来​的​ Agent ​会话​里​收到​结果​，​再​让​ Agent ​读取​日志​并​确认​回调​。

​以下​步骤​使用​ LTC 0.7.0、Linux ​和​ Codex CLI。​准备​好​ Python 3.9 ​或​更新​版本​、Git，​以及​已​登录​的​ Codex CLI。Linux ​任务​由​ systemd ​用户服务​或​ GNU screen ​托管​。​其他​环境​的​步骤​见​安装​指南​。

docs.title: 安装
docs.text:
​在​终端​中​执行​：

git clone --branch v0.7.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/lz59970062/long-task-wakeup.git
cd long-task-wakeup
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python3 -m pip install .
ltc setup --enable --now
ltc --version

setup ​会​安装​ Agent ​技能​并​启动​后台​协调​器​。​最后​一条​命令​应​显示​ 0.7.0。

​保留​这个​虚拟环境​的​位置​，​后台​协调​器会​使用​其中​的​ Python。​接着​在​当前​终端​启动​ Codex CLI；​以后​进入​自己​的​项目​时​，​也​先​激活​这个​环境​，​再启动​ Codex。

docs.title: 提交​第一个​任务
docs.text:
​在​ Codex CLI ​对话​中​，​让​ Codex ​执行​下面​的​命令​。LTC ​会​从​会​话​环境​读取​回调​目标​。

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​第一次​ LTC ​任务​" \
  -- python3 -c "import time; time.sleep(10); print('LTC demo finished')"

--task ​是​任务​名称​，--cwd ​是​工作​目录​，-- ​后面​是​要​执行​的​命令​。​提交​后​，LTC ​会​打印​任务​ ID、​执行​后端​和​日志​路径​，​然后​返回​。​这个​ Python ​程序​会​在​后台​等待​十秒​，​输出​一行​文字​后​结束​。

docs.title: 读取​结果​并​确认​回调
docs.text:
​任务​结束​后​，LTC ​会​把​回调​送回​刚才​的​会​话​。​回调​中​包含​任务​状态​、​日志​路径​和​ ACK ​命令​。​让​ Codex ​打开​日志​，​你​应当​能​看到​：

LTC demo finished

​读完​结果​后​，​让​ Codex ​执行​回调​里​给出​的​完整​ ACK ​命令​。​默认​队列​的​命令​形式​是​：

ltc ack --id <callback-id>

​把​ <callback-id> ​换成​这​条​回调​给出​的​ ID。ACK ​会​把​回调​标记​为​已​收到​，​结束​这​条​回调​的​提醒​。

​需要​查看​待处理​回调​时​，​在​终端​运行​：

ltc status

docs.title: 换成​自己​的​任务
docs.text:
​现在​把​示例​中​的​ Python ​命令​换成​项目​里​的​训练​命令​，​让​ Agent ​在​项目​目录​中​执行​：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​训练​模型​" \
  -- python3 train.py --config configs/exp.yaml

​任务​名​写成​自己​容易​辨认​的​内容​，​例如​“​训练​ ResNet ​基线​”​或​“​构建​ Linux ​安装包​”。Agent ​收到​结果​后​，​就​能​结合​任务​名​、​日志​和​输出​文件​继续​工作​。

​如果​要​交给​子​ Agent ​做​代码​审查​，​可以​使用​：

ltc agent codex --cwd "$PWD" --task "​检查​当前​改动​" \
  -- "​阅读​当前​ git diff，​检查​可能​导致​运行​失败​的​问题​，​报告​文件​位置​和​原因​。"

LTC ​会​打印​子​ Agent ​的​回答​文件​路径​，​并​在​子​任务​结束​后​回调​原会话​。​提示​词​复用​方法​见​ ​编写​任务​模板​。

​接下来​阅读​架构​概览​，​了解​这些​任务​和​回调​由​谁​处理​。

docs.title: 终端​找​不到​ ltc
docs.text:
​激活​安装​ LTC ​的​虚拟环境​，​再​检查​命令​：

source /​安装​目录​/long-task-wakeup/.venv/bin/activate
ltc --version

Windows ​可以​直接​调用​安装​目录​下​的​ .venv\Scripts\ltc.exe。​后台​协调​器​也​使用​安装​时​的​ Python ​路径​，​移动​虚拟环境​后​重新​运行​ ltc setup。

docs.location: troubleshooting/#任务提交时提示会话信息缺失
docs.title: 任务​提交​时​提示​会话​信息​缺失
docs.text:
​让​ Agent ​在​当前​会话​的​工具​环境​中​执行​ ltc run。​从​独立​终端​或​作业​脚本​提交​时​，​传入​ --agent ​和​ --session：

ltc run --agent codex --session "​填入​原会话​ID" --task "​构建​" -- bash scripts/build.sh

​会话​绑定​方式​见​ Codex CLI​和​外部​任务​。

docs.location: troubleshooting/#任务结束后还没看到回调
docs.title: 任务​结束​后​还​没​看到​回调
docs.text:
​先​查看​回调​队列​，​再​检查​当前​会话​配置​：

ltc status --state pending --state running --state failed
ltc doctor --agent codex --session <​原会话​ID>

​按​报告​中​的​具体​项目​处理​：

​情况​ ​下​一步​ ​协调​器​尚未​启动​ ​按​报告​给出​的​ setup ​命令​启动​它​ Claude Code ​会话​正在​打开​ ​让​ Claude ​将​提交​输出​中​的​ ltc wait ​命令​作为​后台​ Bash ​任务​运行​ Codex Desktop ​连接​需要​配置​ ​从​ Desktop ​启动器​启动​应用​ ​回调​进入​ failed ​读取​错误​记录​，​修复​后​在​预览版​中​使用​ ltc retry --id <​回调​ID>

​业务​任务​的​日志​路径​来自​最初​的​提交​输出​。​先​打开​日志​和​产物​，​可以​了解​任务​本身​的​运行​结果​。

docs.title: 同​一条​回调​重复​出现
docs.text: ​读取​结果​后​，​执行​回调​中​的​完整​ ACK ​命令​。​核对​回调​ ID ​和​ --queue-dir，​确认​写入​的​是​同一个​队列​。

docs.title: 重启​后​怎样​继续​训练
docs.text:
​找到​任务​日志​、​结果​文件​和​最近​的​ checkpoint。​让​ Agent ​检查​已有​产物​，​再​使用​训练​程序​自身​的​恢复​参数​提交​后续​任务​，​例如​：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​继续​训练​" -- python train.py --resume outputs/checkpoint.pt

​这里​的​ --resume ​属于​示例​训练​程序​。​换成​你​所用​框架​的​恢复​参数​和​实际​ checkpoint ​路径​。

docs.title: 怎样​反馈​问题
docs.text: ​在​ GitHub Issues​中​附上​操作系统​、LTC ​版本​、​提交​命令​、​错误​文本​和​相关​日志​片段​。​提供​一个​小型​复现​命令​，​便于​定位​发生​问题​的​步骤​。

docs.title: 启动子​ Agent
docs.text: ​一项​工作​能够​独立​描述​时​，​可以​交给​子​ Agent。​例如​检查​某个​模块​、​整理​实验​结果​，​或​根据​需求​实现​一个​小​功能​。

docs.title: 提交​一次​代码​审查
docs.text:
ltc agent codex --cwd "$PWD" --task "​检查​参数​解析​" -- "​阅读​ parser.py ​和​相关​测试​，​检查​空​输入​、​非法​参数​和​边界值​，​报告​问题​的​位置​、​触发​条件​与​修改​建议​。"

codex ​选择​执行​任务​的​子​ Agent。-- ​后面​写​它​要​完成​的​工作​。​把​要​读​的​文件​、​期望​产物​和​判断​标准​写​清楚​，​子​ Agent ​就​可以​围绕​这项​工作​展开​。

​任务​提交​后​，LTC ​会​打印​日志​路径​和​回答​文件​路径​。​子​ Agent ​结束​时​，​回调​返回​发起​任务​的​会​话​。​原会话​读取​回答​、​检查​相关​文件​，​再​继续​处理结果​。

docs.title: 选择​子​ Agent
docs.text:
命令​ ​执行者​ ​版本​ ltc agent codex Codex CLI 0.7.0 ltc agent claude Claude Code CLI 0.7.0 ltc agent pi Pi 0.7.1 ​预览版​

​在​提交​任务​的​环境​中​安装​并​登录​对应​ CLI。​子​ Agent ​会​继承​该​环境​的​配置​、​代理​和​项目​路径​。

​例如​，​在​ Codex ​会话​中​调用​ Claude ​做​审查​：

ltc agent claude --cwd "$PWD" --task "​审查​数据​加载​" -- "​检查​ data_loader.py ​的​文件​读取​、​批次​拼接​和​异常​处理​，​给出​可​复现​的​问题​。"

​结果​仍​回到​这次​提交​所在​的​ Codex ​会话​。​回调​目标​由​提交​会话​决定​，​执行者​由​ agent ​后面​的​名称​决定​。

docs.location: guides/agents/#给任务一个清楚的交接要求
docs.title: 给​任务​一个​清楚​的​交接​要求
docs.text:
​在​提示​词​末尾​说明​希望​看到​的​结果​，​例如​：

​完成​后​列出​修改​的​文件​、​执行​过​的​测试​命令​和​测试​结果​，​并​说明​下​一步​需要​检查​的​内容​。

​经常​重复​的​要求​可以​保存​为​任务​模板​。

docs.title: 接收​与​确认​回调
docs.text: ​回调​告诉​ Agent ​哪项​任务​结束​了​、​结果​放在​哪里​，​以及​如何​确认​收到​。Agent ​先​读取​结果​，​再​执行​回调​给出​的​ ACK ​命令​。

docs.title: 阅读​回调
docs.text:
​通常​会​用到​这些​信息​：

​信息​ ​用途​ ​任务​名称​和​状态​ ​找到​对应​的​工作​，​了解​执行​情况​ ​日志​路径​ ​查看​命令​输出​和​错误信息​ ​回答​或​产物​路径​ ​读取​子​ Agent ​回答​、​报告​或​结果​文件​ Details ​路径​ ​查看​完整​命令​和​交接​要求​ ACK ​命令​ ​确认​这次​结果​已经​收到​并​检查​

​默认​回调​使用​紧凑​格式​。​需要​把​详细​内容​直接​放进​回调​时​，​在​提交​命令​中加​ --callback-format full。

docs.title: 确认​收到
docs.text:
​直接​执行​回调​中​的​完整​命令​，​默认​形式​是​：

ltc ack --id <callback-id>

​使用​自定义​队列​时​，​回调​里​的​命令​还会​带上​ --queue-dir。​保留​这个​参数​，​就​会​写入​对应​队列​的​确认​记录​。

docs.title: 查看​待处理​回调
docs.text:
ltc status
ltc status --state pending --state failed

pending ​表示​正在​等待​投递​，failed ​中​的​回调​需要​结合​错误​记录​处理​。​在​ 0.7.1 ​预览版​中​，​修复​连接​后​可以​重新​投递​已有​回调​：

ltc retry --id <callback-id>

​这​条​命令​再次​发送​已​保存​的​结果​。​需要​运行​新​的​业务​命令​时​，​使用​ ltc run ​提交​新​任务​。

docs.title: 添加​自己​的​交接​习惯
docs.text:
​编辑​ ~/.ltc/callback-hook.md，​例如​写入​：

​读取​结果​后​，​先​告诉​我​产物​路径​和​主要​结论​，​再​继续​下​一步​。
​实验​任务​请​同时​列出​配置文件​和​关键​指标​。

​设置​每次​回调​都​带上​这​段​文字​：

ltc prompt-policy --user-every 1

​查看​当前​提醒​间隔​时​运行​ ltc prompt-policy。​文件​位置​和​环境变量​见​配置​参考​。

docs.title: 接入​已有​任务
docs.text: ​作业​已经​由​ Slurm、tmux ​或​其他​运行​环境​启动​时​，​在​结束​处​调用​ ltc done，​就​能​把​结果​送回​ Agent ​会话​。

docs.title: 报告​一次​运行​结果
docs.text:
​在​原​ Agent ​会话​中​，​下面​的​命令​会​创建​一条​回调​：

ltc done --cwd "$PWD" --task "​生成​数据​索引​" --exit-code 0 --message "​索引​保存​在​ outputs/index.json"

--exit-code ​填​实际​退出​码​，--message ​写​产物​位置​或​交接​说明​。Agent ​收到​回调​后​就​可以​打开​文件​，​继续​使用​结果​。

docs.title: 放进​作业​脚本
docs.text:
​把​原会话​ ID ​填入​脚本​，​在​业务​命令​结束​后​保存​退出​码​，​再​报告​给​ LTC。​下面​是​ Bash ​示例​：

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set +e
python train.py --config configs/exp.yaml
job_exit=$?
ltc done --agent codex --session "​填入​原会话​ID" --cwd "$PWD" \
  --task "Slurm ​训练​" --exit-code "$job_exit" \
  --message "​日志​和​ checkpoint ​保存​在​ outputs/exp/"
exit "$job_exit"

​会话​ ID ​可​在​发起​作业​的​ Codex ​工具​环境​中​通过​ CODEX_THREAD_ID ​获取​。Claude Code ​使用​ CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID。​把​它​保存​进​提交​脚本​，​回调​就​有​明确​的​接收​位置​。

​在​ Slurm ​中​，LTC、​协调​器​和​接收​回调​的​ Agent ​需要​能​访问​同​一份​队列​与会​话​文件​。​使用​共享​目录​时​，​在​ setup、done ​和​ ack ​中​传入​相同​的​ --queue-dir。

docs.title: 只​配置​回调​服务
docs.text:
​如果​这台​机器​只​负责​上报​外部​任务​，​可以​这样​初始化​：

ltc setup --callback-only --enable --now

​接收​结果​后​的​操作​与​其他​任务​一致​，​参阅​接收​与​确认​回调​。

docs.title: 跟踪​多​阶段​目标
docs.text: ​一项​工作​包含​多个​连续​阶段​时​，​用​ Goal ​记录​进度​。​例如​先​训练​模型​，​再​评估​结果​，​最后​生成​报告​。

docs.title: 创建​计划​文件
docs.text:
​在​项目​中​创建​ goal-plan.yaml：

version: 1
revision: 1
goal: ​完成​基线​实验报告​
path:
  - id: train
    title: ​训练​基线​模型​
    status: in_progress
  - id: evaluate
    title: ​评估​模型​并​整理​指标​
    status: pending
  - id: report
    title: ​生成​实验报告​
    status: pending

​步骤​状态​使用​ pending、in_progress、blocked ​或​ completed。​按​执行​顺序​维护​这个​列表​，​完成​一步​后​，​把​下​一步​改为​ in_progress。

docs.title: 绑定​会话
docs.text:
​让​ Codex ​在​当前​会话​的​工具​环境​中​执行​：

ltc goal start --id baseline-report --agent codex --session "$CODEX_THREAD_ID" \
  --cwd "$PWD" --task "​完成​基线​实验报告​" --plan-file goal-plan.yaml

​提交​相关​任务​时​，​附上​这个​目标​的​ ID：

ltc run --goal-id baseline-report --cwd "$PWD" --task "​训练​基线​" -- python train.py

​任务​结束​后​，Agent ​读取​结果​、​确认​回调​并​更新​计划​文件​。​活跃​目标​默认​每三​小时​收到​一次​进度​询问​，​帮助​原会话​继续​处理​当前​步骤​。

docs.title: 完成​目标
docs.text:
​所有​产物​检查​完毕​后​，​将​计划​中​的​步骤​标记​为​ completed，​然后​运行​：

ltc goal check --id baseline-report

​复制​输出​中​的​计划​摘要​，​完成​确认​：

ltc goal ack --id baseline-report --state completed --plan-sha256 <​本次​检查​的​摘要​>

​如果​还​在​等待​数据​或​外部​条件​，​可以​记录​具体情况​：

ltc goal ack --id baseline-report --state blocked_conditions --condition "​等待​数据​集​下载​完成​"

​条件​具备​后​，​执行​ ltc goal resume --id baseline-report ​继续​。​计划​变更​时​更新​ revision，​并​在​文件​里​记录​变更​原因​。

docs.title: 运行​命令
docs.text: ​用​ ltc run ​提交​训练​、​构建​、​测试​或​数据处理​任务​。​请​让​ Agent ​在​当前​会话​中​执行命令​，LTC ​会​记录​这次​任务​的​回调​目标​。

docs.title: 提交​任务
docs.text:
ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​训练​ ResNet ​基线​" -- python train.py --config configs/resnet.yaml

--cwd ​设置​工作​目录​。​配置文件​、​输入​数据​和​输出​目录​中​的​相对路径​，​都​以​这个​目录​为​起点​。--task ​写​一个​容易​辨认​的​名称​，​方便​之后​在​回调​里​找到​这次​运行​。

LTC ​把​ -- ​后面​的​内容​作为​要​执行​的​程序​及其​参数​。​任务​会​继承​提交​时​的​环境​，​所以​先​激活​训练​环境​，​再​让​ Agent ​提交​：

source .venv/bin/activate
ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​运行​测试​" -- python -m pytest tests/

docs.title: 查看​日志
docs.text:
​提交​输出​中​会​给出​ task log ​路径​。​复制​这个​路径​，​用​编辑器​打开​，​或​在​终端​中​查看​最近​的​输出​：

tail -n 60 /​实际​日志​路径​/attempt-1.log

​任务​结束​后​，​回调​也​会​带上​这个​路径​。​让​ Agent ​结合​退出​码​、​日志​和​项目​产物​判断​执行​结果​，​例如​读取​测试​汇总​或​检查​训练​输出​的​ checkpoint。

docs.title: 执行​一段​脚本
docs.text:
​命令​较长​时​，​把​步骤​写​进​脚本​更​容易​维护​：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​构建​安装包​" -- bash scripts/build.sh

​如果​需要​ shell ​管道​或​重定向​，​也​可以​显式​调用​ shell：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​生成​报告​" -- bash -lc 'python analyse.py && python report.py'

​在​ Windows ​上​，​可用​ powershell.exe -File scripts/build.ps1 ​作为​实际​命令​。

docs.title: 指定​执行​后​端
docs.text:
​默认​的​ --backend auto ​根据​操作系统​选择​后​端​。​在​使用​ GNU screen ​的​服务器​或​容器​中​，​可以​明确​选择​：

ltc run --backend screen --cwd "$PWD" --task "​训练​模型​" -- python train.py

​安装​与​后​端​配置​见​安装​指南​。​完成​后​的​处理​步骤​见​接收​与​确认​回调​。

docs.title: 编写​任务​模板
docs.text: ​把​经常​重复​的​任务​要求​保存​为​ YAML，​下次​提交​时​只​补充​本次​的​文件​和​目标​。

docs.title: 写​一个​审查​模板
docs.text:
​在​项目​中​创建​ review.yaml：

version: 1
prompt: |
  ​阅读​提供​的​需求​和​代码​，​检查​会​影响​实际​运行​的​问题​。
  ​每个​问题​给出​文件​位置​、​触发​条件​、​预期​行为​和​实际​行为​。
  ​以​审查​报告​交付​结果​。
handoff: |
  ​逐项​核对​审查​结果​，​确认​问题​后​再​安排​修改​和​测试​。

prompt ​是子​ Agent ​的​任务​要求​，handoff ​是​返回​原会​话​后​的​处理​要求​。

docs.title: 使用​模板
docs.text:
​先​预览​展开​后​的​提示​词​：

ltc agent codex --template-file ./review.yaml --dry-run -- "​检查​ parser.py ​和​ tests/test_parser.py。"

​查看​输出​后​，​提交​任务​：

ltc agent codex --template-file ./review.yaml --cwd "$PWD" --task "​解析器​审查​" -- "​检查​ parser.py ​和​ tests/test_parser.py。"

-- ​后面​的​文字​会​追加​到​模板​提示​词中​。LTC ​在​提交​时​保存​展开​后​的​内容​，​便于​追溯​这次​任务​使用​的​要求​。

docs.title: 在​多个​项目​中​复用
docs.text:
​将​文件​保存​为​ ~/.config/ltc/templates/review.yaml，​就​可以​按​名称​调用​：

ltc agent codex --template review --task "​审查​当前​改动​" -- "​阅读​当前​ git diff，​检查​行为​变化​。"

docs.title: 注册​为​ Agent ​技能
docs.text:
0.7.1 ​预览版​支持​把​模板​注册​为​ Agent ​可​发现​的​技能​：

ltc template register review --file ./review.yaml --worker codex --description "​审查​代码​并​报告​可​复现​的​问题​"
ltc template list

​注册​后​，Codex ​可以​使用​ $ltc-review，Claude Code ​可以​使用​ /ltc-review ​调用​它​。​注册​字​段​、​文件​位置​和​更新​方式​见​模板​注册​资料​。

docs.title: 典型​使用​场景
docs.text: ​先​选择​工作​由​谁​执行​：​普通​程序​交给​ ltc run，​独立​的​分析​或​开发​工作​交给​ ltc agent，​已​在​调度​系统​中​运行​的​作业​通过​ ltc done ​上报​。​下面​的​命令​在​已​配置​ LTC ​的​ Agent ​会话​中​执行​，​文件名​替换​为​自己​项目​中​的​实际​路径​。

docs.title: 训练​结束​后​接着​评估
docs.text:
​你​正在​调试​一个​模型​，​希望​训练​完成​后​由​ Agent ​读取​指标​、​检查​ checkpoint，​并​安排​评估​。

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​训练​基线​模型​" -- python train.py --config configs/baseline.yaml

​提交​前​告诉​ Agent：

​训练​结束​后​读取​日志​，​记录​最终​指标​和​ checkpoint ​路径​。​确认​产物​后​ ACK，​再​使用​这个​ checkpoint ​运行​评估​，​把​结果​写入​ reports/baseline.md。

​训练​程序​负责​保存​ checkpoint。Agent ​根据​回调​中​的​退出​码​和​日志​决定​继续​评估​，​还是​先​处理​训练​错误​。​需要​持续​记录​每个​阶段​时​，​使用​多​阶段​目标​。

docs.location: guides/use-cases/#测试或构建完成后处理失败项
docs.title: 测试​或​构建​完成​后处理​失败​项
docs.text:
​完整​测试​需要​较长时间​时​，​可以​提交​一次​后台​运行​：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​完整​测试​" -- python -m pytest tests/ --junitxml=reports/tests.xml

Agent ​收到​结果​后​打开​日志​和​ reports/tests.xml，​定位​失败​用例​，​再​对​修改​过​的​部分​运行​测试​。​构建​也​采用​相同​流程​：​将​命令​换成​ bash scripts/build.sh，​并​在​交接​要求​中​写明​需要​检查​的​安装包​路径​。

docs.title: 让​另​一个​ Agent ​审查​代码
docs.text:
​在​ Codex ​中​让​ Claude ​检查​一个​模块​：

ltc agent claude --cwd "$PWD" --task "​审查​数据​加载​" -- "​阅读​ data_loader.py ​和​相关​测试​，​检查​缺失​文件​、​空​数据​和​批次​边界​。​给出​问题​位置​、​复现​步骤​和​修复​建议​。"

Claude ​的​回答​保存​在​任务​目录​中​，​结果​回到​发起​请求​的​ Codex ​会话​。Codex ​读取​报告​、​核对​问题​并​安排​修改​。​将​固定​的​审查​要求​写成​任务​模板​，​下次​只​需​补充​本次​文件​。

docs.title: 接收​ Slurm ​或​ tmux ​作业​的​结果
docs.text:
​作业​已经​在​集群​或​ tmux ​中​执行​时​，​在​脚本​结尾​上报​：

ltc done --agent codex --session "​填入​原会话​ID" --task "​集群​训练​完成​" \
  --exit-code "$job_exit" --message "​结果​保存​在​ /shared/experiments/baseline/"

job_exit ​在​业务​命令​退出​后​立即​用​ job_exit=$? ​保存​。​发起​端​、​上​报端​和​协调​器​使用​同一个​队列​目录​，​接收​回调​的​ Agent ​能​读取​结果​路径​。​完整​脚本​见​接入​已有​任务​。

docs.location: guides/use-cases/#数据处理结束后检查产物
docs.title: 数据处理​结束​后​检查​产物
docs.text:
ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​生成​检索​索引​" -- python build_index.py --output outputs/index

​在​交接​要求​中​指定​检查​方法​，​例如​核对​输入​和​输出​条数​、​抽查​十条​记录​、​运行​一次​检索​查询​。Agent ​收到​回调​后​按​这些​步骤​检查​产物​，​再​生成​简短​的​数据​质量​报告​。

docs.title: 运行​自定义​ Agent ​工作​流
docs.text:
​如果​项目​把​自己​的​ Agent ​工作​流​封装​成​ Python ​入口​，​可以​把​它​作为​普通​命令​提交​：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​分析​文档​集合​" -- python workflows/analyse_documents.py

​在​脚本​中​保存​报告​和​中间​产物​，​结果​回到​提交​它​的​ Codex、Claude ​或​ Pi ​会话​。​需要​让​自定义​ harness ​自己​接收​回调​时​，​按​框架​接入​说明​实现​会话​适配器​。

docs.title: 选择​回调​入口
docs.text:
当前​使用​的​环境​ ​推荐​操作​ Codex CLI ​在​当前​会话​提交​，​让​协调​器​恢复​同一个​会话​ Claude Code CLI ​或​桌面​ Code ​会话​ ​提交​后​把​输出​中​的​ ltc wait ​命令​作为​后台​ Bash ​任务​运行​ Pi ​安装​扩展​，​在​当前​ Pi ​进程​接收​回调​；​需要​关闭​后​恢复​时​从​ ltc pi ​启动​ Codex Desktop ​使用​预览版​共享​ Core ​启动器​，​再​运行​小​任务​检查​回调​

​对应​版本​和​验证​记录​见​ Harness ​支持​情况​。

docs.title: 接入​ Claude Code
docs.text: ​实时​接收​回调​使用​ 0.7.1 ​预览版​。​按​安装​指南​安装​后​，​运行​ ltc setup，​让​ Claude Code ​加载​ LTC ​技能​。

docs.title: 提交​任务​并​接收​结果
docs.text:
​让​ Claude ​在​当前​会话​里​提交​：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​运行​测试​" -- python -m pytest tests/

​提交​输出​会​给出​一条​ ltc wait ​命令​，​例如​：

ltc wait --queue-dir ~/.ltc/queue --task <task-id>

​让​ Claude ​使用​ Bash ​工具​的​ run_in_background: true ​执行​输出​中​的​完整​命令​。​任务​结果​进入​队列​后​，ltc wait ​输出​回调​并​退出​，Claude Code ​接着​处理​这​条​后台​命令​的​完成​消息​。

Claude ​读取​日志​和​产物​后​，​执行​回调​中​的​ ltc ack ​命令​。​这个​流程​可​用于​终端​ CLI，​也​可​用于​ Claude ​桌面​应用​的​ Code ​会话​。

docs.title: 用​自然语言​安排​工作
docs.text:
​安装​技能​后​，​可以​直接​说​：

​用​ LTC ​跑​完整​测试​。​收到​结果​后​，​打开​失败​测试​的​日志​，​定位​原因​并​给出​修改​建议​。

​技能​会​引导​ Claude ​提交​任务​、​后台​运行​ waiter、​读取​结果​和​确认​回调​。

docs.title: 配置​ CLI
docs.text:
​如果​需要​启动​ Claude ​子​ Agent，​或​在​会​话​关闭​后​通过​ CLI ​恢复​，​先​在​这台​机器​上​完成​登录​：

claude auth login
claude auth status

​在​当前​会话​的​工具​环境​中​检查​ LTC：

ltc doctor --agent claude --session "$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID"

SSH ​工作​时​，​在​运行​任务​的​远程​主​机上安装​ LTC ​和​技能​。​二进制​定位​、​会话​目录​及​ channel ​接入​详见​ Claude Code ​实现​资料​。

docs.title: 接入​ Codex CLI
docs.text: ​先​按​安装​指南​安装​ LTC，​并​在​启动​ Codex ​的​终端​中​激活​ LTC ​所在​的​虚拟环境​。

docs.title: 在​会​话​中​提交
docs.text:
​让​ Codex ​执行​：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​构建​项目​" -- bash scripts/build.sh

LTC ​从​ Codex ​的​工具​环境​中​读取​ CODEX_THREAD_ID，​把​这次​任务​绑定​到​当前​会话​。​结束​后​，​协调​器​恢复​这个​会话​，​并​送入​任务​结果​。

​日常​使用​时​，​你​可以​直接​对​ Codex ​说​：

​用​ LTC ​运行​这次​构建​，​结束​后​读取​日志​，​检查​输出​的​安装包​，​再​告诉​我​结果​。

ltc setup ​安装​的​技能​包含​提交​任务​、​读取​回调​和​ ACK ​的​操作​方式​。

docs.title: 指定​接收​会话
docs.text:
​从​其他​脚本​提交​时​，​显式​传入​会话​ ID：

ltc run --agent codex --session "​填入​原会话​ID" --cwd "$PWD" --task "​构建​项目​" -- bash scripts/build.sh

​使用​原会话​对应​的​ CODEX_HOME，​可以​让​ LTC ​找到​同​一份​会话​记录​和​配置​。​默认​配置​目录​是​ ~/.codex。

docs.title: 检查​配置
docs.text:
​在​ Codex ​工具​环境​中​执行​：

ltc doctor --agent codex --session "$CODEX_THREAD_ID"

​根据​报告​中​的​修复​命令​处理​安装​、​协调​器​或​会​话​配置​，​再​运行​十秒​示例​确认​回调​到达​。

​桌面​应用​的​接入​步骤​见​ Codex Desktop。

docs.title: 接入​ Codex Desktop
docs.text: Codex Desktop ​接入​使用​ 0.7.1 ​预览版​的​共享​ Core ​启动器​。Desktop ​和​ LTC ​通过​同一个​ Core ​访问​会话​，​任务​结束​后​把​回调​送回​桌面​应用​。

docs.title: 生成​启动器
docs.text:
​在​ macOS ​或​ Windows ​上​完成​预览版​安装​，​然后​运行​：

ltc setup --force --enable --now
ltc desktop status

macOS ​会​生成​ Start LTC Desktop.command；Windows ​会​生成​ Start LTC Desktop.cmd ​和​对应​的​ PowerShell ​脚本​。​默认​位置​是​用户​ Codex ​配置​目录​下​的​ long-task-wakeup ​文件夹​。

docs.title: 启动​ Desktop
docs.text:
​保存​当前工作​并​退出​ Desktop，​再​双击​生成​的​启动器​，​或​运行​：

ltc desktop launch

​之后​从​这个​ Desktop ​会话​提交​一个​小​任务​：

ltc run --callback-mode desktop --cwd "$PWD" --task "Desktop ​回调​示例​" -- python -c "print('Desktop callback ready')"

​让​ Agent ​读取​结果​并​执行​回调​中​的​ ACK，​完成​一次​接入​检查​。PowerShell ​工具​环境​中将​ --cwd "$PWD" ​换成​ --cwd "$($PWD.Path)"。

docs.title: 调整​应用​路径
docs.text:
macOS ​同时​安装​多个​应用​时​，​可以​明确​选择​：

ltc desktop prepare --app /Applications/Codex.app --force

Windows ​默认​使用​直接​启动​方式​。Store ​包​上下文​启动​是​实验​选项​，​配置​命令​是​：

ltc setup --desktop-launch-mode package-context --force --enable --now

​各​平台​的​启动​步骤​、​运行​条件​和​验证​记录​见​ macOS Desktop​与​ Windows Desktop。​应用​升级​后​，​再用​上面​的​示例​检查​回调​。

docs.title: 接入​ Pi
docs.text: Pi ​接入​使用​ 0.7.1 ​预览版​。Pi ​既​可以​接收​自己​提交​的​任务​结果​，​也​可以​作为​子​ Agent ​执行​独立​工作​。

docs.title: 安装​扩展
docs.text:
​按​预览版​安装​步骤​安装​ LTC，​然后​执行​：

ltc setup --with-pi-extension --enable --now

​在​已经​打开​的​普通​ Pi ​会话​中​执行​ /reload，​或​重新启动​ Pi。​扩展​和​技能​会​安装​到​ Pi ​配置​目录​，​默认​是​ ~/.pi/agent。

docs.title: 在​ Pi ​中​提交​任务
docs.text:
​让​ Pi ​执行​：

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "​整理​数据​" -- python prepare_data.py

LTC ​将​任务​绑定​到​ PI_SESSION_FILE ​指向​的​会​话​。​结果​到达​后​，​扩展​把​回调​送入​这个​ Pi ​进程​。Pi ​空闲​时​开始​处理​回调​；​正在​工作​时​，​在​当前​工具​调用​结束​后​接入​这​条​消息​。

​读完​产物​后​，​让​ Pi ​执行​回调​中​的​ ACK ​命令​。

docs.title: 使用​ LTC ​启动​ Pi
docs.text:
​需要​在​ Pi ​关闭​后​恢复​会话​时​，​用​ LTC ​启动​一个​受​托管​的​会​话​：

ltc pi --cwd "$PWD"

​继续​已有​会话​时​，​给出​完整​路径​：

ltc pi --session /absolute/path/to/session.jsonl

docs.title: 把​工作​交给​ Pi
docs.text:
​在​原​ Agent ​会话​中​提交​：

ltc agent pi --cwd "$PWD" --task "​检查​数据处理​" -- "​阅读​ prepare_data.py，​检查​缺失​值​、​重复记录​和​输出​格式​，​报告​具体​问题​。"

​子​任务​回答​会​保存​在​ LTC ​任务​目录​中​，​路径​随​提交​输出​和​回调​一起​提供​。​模型​参数​、​系统​提示​词和会​话​恢复​细节​见​ Pi ​实现​资料​。

docs.title: Harness ​支持​情况
docs.text:
Harness ​指​运行​ Agent ​的​外层​程序​：​它​管理​会话​、​调用​模型​、​执行​工具​，​并​把​新​消息​交给​ Agent。LTC ​的​接入​涉及​两件事​：​启动​它​作为​子​ Agent，​以及​把​任务​结果​送回​它​的​原会话​。

​以下​按​当前​ main ​的​实现​和​仓库​验证​记录​整理​，​核对​日期​为​ 2026-10-12。​快速​开始​使用​正式版​ 0.7.0，​新增​接入​使用​ 0.7.1 ​预览版​。

docs.title: 原生​接入
docs.text:
Harness / ​客户端​ ​作为​子​ Agent ​原会话​接收​结果​ ​版本​与​验证​情况​ Codex CLI ltc agent codex ​使用​ CODEX_THREAD_ID ​绑定​会话​，​通过​ CLI ​恢复​ 0.7.0；​正式版​与​平台​验证​记录​见下文​ Claude Code CLI ltc agent claude ​后台​ ltc wait ​实时​接收​；​独立​ CLI ​可​恢复​会话​ ​子​ Agent、CLI ​恢复​从​ 0.7.0 ​起​；​实时​回调​为​ 0.7.1 ​预览​，Linux/macOS ​已​验证​ Claude ​桌面​应用​的​ Code ​会话​ ​子​任务​通过​已​登录​的​独立​ Claude CLI ​执行​ ​后台​ Bash ​运行​ ltc wait 0.7.1 ​预览​；macOS ​本地​会话​、Linux SSH ​会话​已​验证​ Pi ltc agent pi ​扩展​向​当前​进程​发送​ steer ​消息​；ltc pi ​增加​关闭​后​的​会​话​恢复​ 0.7.1 ​预览​；Linux、Pi 0.87.1 ​有​验证​记录​，macOS/Windows ​待​验证​ Codex Desktop ​子​任务​使用​ Codex CLI ​共享​ Core ​启动器​和​ --callback-mode desktop 0.7.1 ​预览​；​新​安装​路径​的​真实​ Desktop ​重启​、​接收​和​ ACK ​验收​待​完成​

​子​ Agent ​与​接收​方​可以​组合​。​例如​在​ Codex ​中​执行​ ltc agent claude，Claude ​执行​任务​，​结果​回到​ Codex。​操作步骤​见​ Codex、Claude、Pi​和​ Desktop。

Claude ​还​提供​ ltc claude channel ​研究​预览​入口​，​已​记录​ Linux ​上​ Claude Code 2.1.296 ​的​实时​接收​与​ ACK。​配置​步骤​见​ channel ​说明​。

docs.title: 其他​ Harness ​和​编排​框架
docs.text:
名称​ ​当前​接入​方式​ ​后续​原生​接入​工作​ Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Aider、Goose ​可​将​已​配置​的​命令行​任务​放在​ ltc run -- <​命令​> ​后​执行​，​结果​交回​现有​接收​方​ ​实现​各自​的​子​ Agent ​参数​、​会话​识别​和​回调​传输​；​逐项​进行​端到​端​验证​ LangGraph、AutoGen、CrewAI、​自定义​ Agent SDK ​程序​ ​将​工作​流​保存​为​脚本​，​通过​ ltc run ​执行​，​或​在​已有​任务​末尾​调用​ ltc done ​为​接收​回调​的​会​话​实现​适配器​与​唤醒​通道​ DSH ​仓库​路线图​中​规划​了​适配器​ ​完成​实现​与​验证​后​加入​原生​接入​表​

​这些​框架​目前​处于​通用​命令​接入​层​，​仓库​原生​适配器​注册表​包含​ codex、claude、pi。​开始​接入​时​，​先​让​脚本​打印​一行​结果​并​正常​退出​，​再​检查​日志​、​回调​和​ ACK；​随后​接入​实际​工作​流​。​脚本​示例​见​典型​使用​场景​。

docs.title: 执行​环境
docs.text:
环境​ ​任务​后​端​ ​使用​条件​ Linux systemd ​用户服务​、GNU screen ​桌面​或​服务器​；​容器​和​ SSH ​环境​可用​ screen macOS launchd、GNU screen launchd ​使用​当前​登录​用户​的​ GUI ​会话​ Windows 10+ Task Scheduler、Job Object ​当前​用户​保持​登录​，​任务​状态​使用​本地​ NTFS ​目录​

​任务​执行​后端​随​ 0.7.0 ​发布​。​选择​具体​ Harness ​时​，​再​按​上表​配置​其​回调​入口​。Claude ​实时​回调​的​ Windows ​验证​仍待​完成​。

docs.title: 接入​新​的​ Harness
docs.text:
​从​仓库​的​ agents/base.py ​和​ agents/registry.py ​开始​：

  1. ​实现​子​ Agent ​启动​：​定位​程序​、​构造​命令​、​传入​提示​词​，​并​约定​回答​写入​文件​还是​标准​输出​。
  2. ​定义​会话​绑定​：​读取​当前​会话​标识​，​保存​恢复​会话​需要​的​ profile ​和​目录​。
  3. ​接入​回调​：​为​关闭​的​会​话​构造​恢复​命令​；​为​正在​运行​的​会​话​提供​能​送入​新​消息​的​通道​。
  4. ​在​适配器​注册表​登记​，​补齐​ CLI ​选择​、​安装​入口​及​该​ Harness ​的​操作技能​。
  5. ​使用​独立​会话​验证​提交​、​日志​、​结果​、​接收​、ACK，​并​检查​忙碌​、​退出​和​重试​时​的​行为​。

ChildAgentAdapter ​描述​子​任务​接口​，AgentAdapter ​增加​会话​识别​与​恢复​。​按​这​两个​接口​组织​实现​，​可以​分别​验证​任务​执行​和​结果​投递​。

docs.title: 命令​速查
docs.text:
​查看​完整​参数​：

ltc --help
ltc run --help
ltc agent --help

docs.title: 安装​和​检查
docs.text: 命令​ ​用途​ ltc --version ​查看​当前​版本​ ltc setup --enable --now ​安装​技能​并​启动​协调​器​ ltc setup --keep-skill --force --enable --now ​更新​协调​器​，​保留​技能​内容​ ltc doctor --agent codex --session <id> ​检查​指定​会话​的​运行​配置

docs.title: 提交​工作
docs.text:
命令​ ​用途​ ltc run --task <​名称​> -- <​命令​> ​提交​一个​命令​ ltc agent codex -- <​任务​> ​启动​ Codex ​子​ Agent ltc agent claude -- <​任务​> ​启动​ Claude ​子​ Agent ltc done --task <​名称​> --exit-code <​退出​码​> ​报告​外部​任务​结果​

​提交​参数​写​在​ -- ​前面​：

​参数​ ​用途​ --cwd <​目录​> ​工作​目录​ --task <​名称​> ​回调​中​显示​的​任务​名称​ --agent <​类型​> ​接收​回调​的​ Agent ​类型​ --session <​会话​> ​接收​回调​的​会​话​ --queue-dir <​目录​> ​回调​队列​位置​ --backend auto ​自动​选择​任务​执行​后​端​ --goal-id <​目标​> ​关联​多​阶段​目标​ --callback-format full ​使用​完整​回调​文本

docs.title: 处理​回调
docs.text: 命令​ ​用途​ ltc status ​查看​待处理​回调​ ltc status --state failed ​查看​投递​失败​的​回调​ ltc ack --id <​回调​ID> ​确认​已经​读取​结果​ ltc cancel --id <​回调​ID> ​撤销​这​条​回调​的​投递​ ltc prompt-policy ​查看​提醒​间隔

docs.title: 预览版​命令
docs.text:
​以下​命令​使用​ 0.7.1 ​预览版​：

​命令​ ​用途​ ltc wait --task <​任务​ID> ​在​ Claude Code ​中​等待​并​输出​回调​ ltc retry --id <​回调​ID> ​重新​投递​保存​的​回调​ ltc agent pi -- <​任务​> ​启动​ Pi ​子​ Agent ltc pi ​打开​ LTC ​托管​的​ Pi ​会话​ ltc template list ​查看​已​注册​模板​ ltc desktop status ​查看​ Desktop ​连接​配置​ ltc desktop launch ​通过​共享​ Core ​启动​ Desktop

​多​阶段​目标​的​命令​顺序​见​目标​指南​。

docs.title: 配置​与​文件​位置
docs.text: LTC ​保存​任务​命令​、​日志​、​执行​结果​和​回调​记录​。​需要​排错​或​继续​工作​时​，​可以​从​这些​文件​找到​上次​运行​的​信息​。

docs.title: 默认​目录
docs.text:
位置​ ​内容​ ~/.ltc/tasks/<task-id>/task.json ​命令​、​工作​目录​、​后端​和​会​话​绑定​ ~/.ltc/tasks/<task-id>/attempt-1.log ​第一次​执行​的​输出​日志​ ~/.ltc/tasks/<task-id>/result.json ​退出​码​与​执行​结果​ ~/.ltc/queue/ ​回调​及其​投递​状态​ ~/.ltc/callback-hook.md ​用户​追加​的​回调​提示​词​ ~/.ltc/callback-prompts.yaml ​回调​提醒​间隔​ ~/.config/ltc/templates/ ​可​复用​的​任务​模板​

​子​ Agent ​的​回答​文件​和​回调​详情​文件​路径​会​出现​在​提交​输出​或​回调​里​。​按​给出​的​路径​读取​即可​。

docs.title: 常用​环境变量
docs.text:
变量​ ​用途​ LTC_HOME ​设置​ LTC ​状态​目录​，​默认​ ~/.ltc CODEX_HOME Codex ​配置​与会​话​目录​，​默认​ ~/.codex CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR Claude Code ​配置​目录​，​默认​ ~/.claude PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR Pi ​配置​目录​，​默认​ ~/.pi/agent LTC_TEMPLATE_DIR ​自定义​模板​目录​

~ ​表示​当前​用户​的​主目录​；Windows ​中​对应​用户​配置​文件目录​。

docs.title: 使用​自定义​队列
docs.text:
​先​确定​一个​绝对路径​，​然后​在​安装​、​提交​和​确认​时​使用​同一个​目录​：

ltc setup --queue-dir /absolute/path/to/ltc-queue --enable --now
ltc run --queue-dir /absolute/path/to/ltc-queue --task "​测试​" -- python -m pytest
ltc status --queue-dir /absolute/path/to/ltc-queue

​切换​已有​协调​器​的​队列​时​，​先​处理​完原​队列​里​的​工作​，​再​重新配置​。​并行​运行​多套​ LTC ​时​，​为​每套​配置​独立​的​ Agent profile ​和​队列​。

docs.title: 修改​回调​提示​词
docs.text:
​编辑​ callback-hook.md，​写入​每次​处理结果​时​希望​ Agent ​遵循​的​习惯​。LTC ​会​在​到期​的​提醒​中​读取​文件​最新​内容​。​设置​提醒​间隔​：

ltc prompt-policy --system-every 4 --user-every 3

​两个​数字​分别​控制系统​提示​和​用户​提示​的​间隔​。​设​为​ 1，​表示​每条​回调​都​附带​对应​提示​。

docs.title: 参与​文档​维护
docs.text: ​文档​源文件​和​代码​保存​在​同一个​仓库​。​修改​对应​ Markdown ​文件​，​构建​后​就​可以​预览​页面​。

docs.title: 本地​预览
docs.text:
​在​仓库​根目录​中​运行​：

python3 -m venv .venv-docs
source .venv-docs/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs serve

​打开​终端​给出​的​本地​地址​。​修改​文件​后​，​页面​会​自动更新​。

docs.title: 添加​一篇​教程
docs.text:
​按​内容​选择​位置​：

​目录​ ​内容​ docs/guides/ ​完成​一项​具体​工作​的​操作步骤​ docs/integrations/ ​各​ Agent ​的​配置​与​使用​ docs/reference/ ​参数​、​配置​和​开发​资料​

​中文​文件​使用​ topic.md，​英文​使用​同​目录​的​ topic.en.md。​在​ mkdocs.yml ​的​ nav ​中​加入​基础​文件名​，​再​在​ nav_translations ​中​填写​英文​标题​。​两种​语言​中​的​链接​都​写​基础​文件名​，​例如​ ../installation.md，​构建​时会​自动​指向​对应​语言​。

​从​相关​教程​链接​到​新页面​。​中文​沿用​站点​根​路径​，​英文​位于​ /en/；​顶部​语言​菜单​可以​切换​到​当前​页面​的​另​一种​语言​。

​一篇​教程​从​读者​要​做​的​事​开始​，​给出​可​执行​的​命令​，​说明​预期​输出​和​下​一步​。​参数​限制​写成​具体​的​配置​要求​，​遇到​问题​给出​处理​步骤​。

docs.title: 检查​与​发布
docs.text:
​提交​前​运行​：

python scripts/docs_sync.py check
mkdocs build --strict
python scripts/docs_sync.py export

​构建​会​检查​配置​和​文档​链接​。​合并​到​ main ​后​，GitHub Actions ​构建​并​发布​ GitHub Pages。

​检查​命令​要求​导航​中​的​每​一页​都​有​中英文​版本​。​导出​命令​生成​ GitBook ​的​双语​ Markdown、​目录​和​配置​。​各​平台​的​首次​接入​与​自动​同步​步骤​见​文档​发布​与​同步​。

docs.text: ​所有​教程​在​ GitHub ​仓库​的​ docs/ ​中​维护​。​中文​文件​使用​ .md，​英文​使用​ .en.md。​每次​更新​ main，​发布​流程​检查​双语​覆盖​、​构建​站点​，​并​更新​ GitBook ​导出​分支​。

docs.title: 发布​入口
docs.text:
平台​ ​仓库​中​的​配置​ ​接入​后​的​更新​方式​ GitHub Pages .github/workflows/docs.yml ​已​启用​；​提交​到​ main ​后​自动更新​ Read the Docs .readthedocs.yaml ​导入​仓库​后​，​由​ webhook ​触发​构建​ Cloudflare Pages wrangler.toml ​和​下方​构建​参数​ ​连接​ GitHub ​仓库​后​自动​构建​ GitLab Pages .gitlab-ci.yml、​可​选​ GitHub ​同步​任务​ GitHub ​推送​源文件​到​ GitLab，​再​由​ GitLab CI ​发布​ GitBook ​自动​生成​的​ gitbook-zh、gitbook-en ​分支​ ​两个​ Space ​分别​连接​对应​分支​，​通过​语言​ variants ​发布​

GitHub Pages ​已​上线​。​其他​四个​平台​的​配置​和​内容​导出​已​准备​好​，​首次​发布​需要​在​对应​账号​中​创建​或​关联​项目​。

docs.title: GitHub Pages
docs.text:
​推送​文档​到​ main ​后​，​在​仓库​ Actions ​查看​ Documentation ​工作​流​。​它​先​构建​，​再​更新​ gh-pages ​分支​并​请求​ Pages ​发布​。

​中文​首页​位于​站点​根​路径​，​英文​位于​ en/。​顶部​语言​菜单​切换​到​当前​页面​的​另​一种​语言​。

docs.title: Read the Docs
docs.text:
1. ​登录​ Read the Docs，​导入​ lz59970062/long-task-wakeup。
  2. ​使用​ main ​分支​和​仓库​根目录​的​ .readthedocs.yaml，​项目​语言选择​简体中文​。
  3. ​触发​第一次​构建​，​打开​项目​给出​的​公开​地址​，​检查​语言​菜单​。
  4. ​在​项目​的​集成​设置​中​确认​ GitHub webhook ​已​连接​，​后续​提交​即可​自动更新​。

​一个​构建​包含​两种​语言​。​构建​钩子​读取​平台​提供​的​ READTHEDOCS_CANONICAL_URL，​语言​链接​和​ sitemap ​使用​当前​站点​的​完整​路径​。​配置​方式​见​ Read the Docs ​的​ MkDocs ​指南​。

docs.title: Cloudflare Pages
docs.text:
​在​ Cloudflare ​的​ Workers & Pages ​中​创建​ Pages ​项目​，​连接​同一个​ GitHub ​仓库​，​填写​：

​设置​ ​值​ Production branch main Root directory ​仓库​根目录​ Build command pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && python scripts/docs_sync.py check && mkdocs build --strict Build output directory site ​环境变量​ PYTHON_VERSION=3.12

​仓库​中​的​ wrangler.toml ​也​指定​了​ site ​输出​目录​。​站点​地址​从​ CF_PAGES_URL ​读取​。​使用​自定义​域名​时​，​将​ LTC_DOCS_SITE_URL ​设置​为​完整​公开​地址​。​流程​见​ Cloudflare ​的​ MkDocs ​部署​指南​。

docs.title: GitLab Pages
docs.text:
​在​ GitLab ​创建​一个​空​项目​，​默认​分支​使用​ main。​在​ GitHub ​仓库​的​ Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions ​中​添加​：

​类型​ ​名称​ ​值​ Repository variable DOCS_GITLAB_REPOSITORY GitLab ​项目​的​ HTTPS ​克隆​地址​ Repository secret DOCS_GITLAB_TOKEN ​有​该​项目​ write_repository ​权限​的​访问​令牌​

​令牌​保存​在​ GitHub Secrets ​中​。​手动​运行​一次​ Documentation ​工作​流​，sync-gitlab ​会​将​当前​提交​推送​到​ GitLab ​的​ main。​之后​每次​文档​更新​都​会​同步​。GitLab ​使用​ .gitlab-ci.yml ​构建​并​发布​ site，​站点​地址​从​ CI_PAGES_URL ​读取​。

​在​ GitLab ​的​ Deploy → Pages ​查看​公开​地址​，​项目​的​ Pages ​访问​设置​选择​公开​。​配置​使用​ GitLab 17.10 ​及​更新​版本​的​ pages.publish，​参阅​ GitLab Pages ​指南​。

docs.title: GitBook
docs.text:
GitHub Actions ​生成​两个​内容​分支​，​每个​分支​都​有​ Markdown、SUMMARY.md、.gitbook.yaml ​和​记录​源​提交​的​ sync-manifest.json。

  1. ​在​ GitBook ​建立​中文​与​英文​两个​ Space。
  2. ​为​中文​ Space ​开启​ Git Sync，​连接​本​仓库​的​ gitbook-zh ​分支​；​英文​连接​ gitbook-en。
  3. ​首次​同步​选择​从​ GitHub ​导入​内容​，​目录​由​ SUMMARY.md ​提供​。
  4. ​在​同一个​ GitBook ​文档​站​中​把​两个​ Space ​配成​语言​ variants，​名称​分别​为​“​简体中文​”​和​“English”，​然后​发布​。

​源文件​继续​在​ main ​的​ docs/ ​中​修改​。​同步​流程​会​更新​两个​导出​分支​，GitBook ​随之​同步​。​导出​时​，MkDocs ​按钮​会​转成​普通​链接​，​安装​步骤​的​页​签会​转成​小节​标题​。GitBook ​的​语言​ variants ​配置​见​官方​教程​。

​本地​检查​导出​内容​：

python scripts/docs_sync.py export

​文件​位于​ build/gitbook/zh/ ​和​ build/gitbook/en/。

docs.title: 检查​一次​同步
docs.text:
​先​确认​ GitHub Documentation ​构建​成功​，​再​打开​目标​平台​的​新页面​。​切换​语言​，​检查​代码​块​、​站​内​链接​和​搜索​。GitBook ​的​ sync-manifest.json ​中​记录​源​提交​，​可以​和​这次​ GitHub ​提交​核对​。

LTC_DOCS_SITE_URL ​可​覆盖​自动识别​的​地址​，​适合​自定义​域名​。​值​使用​站点​根目录​的​完整​ URL，​并​保留​末尾​的​ /。

docs.title: Long Task Callback
docs.text:
Long Task Callback (LTC) brings an Agent back to the same conversation when a long task finishes. Submit a training run, test suite, or code review, and let it run in the background. LTC sends the result paths back to the conversation so the Agent can read the logs and artifacts and continue working.

Get started Explore the architecture

docs.title: Start with a task
docs.text:
Ask the Agent to submit a training command from its current session:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Train the model" -- python train.py --config configs/exp.yaml

LTC returns a task ID and a log path. When the task finishes, the original session receives a callback. The Agent checks the output and runs the ACK command included in the callback. Start with the ten-second example in Your first task.

docs.title: Choose an entry point
docs.text:
What you want to do Where to start Run training, tests, builds, or data processing Running commands Give another Agent a self-contained piece of work Running child agents Receive results from jobs already running in Slurm or tmux External jobs Reuse review or analysis instructions Task templates Track training, evaluation, and reporting as one goal Multi-stage goals

For worked examples, see Use cases.

docs.title: Set up your environment
docs.text:
LTC runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows. Follow Installation, then choose your Agent: Codex CLI, Claude Code, Pi, or Codex Desktop. The support matrix lists versions, callback routes, and validation records.

The quickstart uses stable version 0.7.0. Claude live callbacks, Pi, and the Desktop launcher use the 0.7.1 preview, with setup steps on each integration page.

docs.title: Keep reading
docs.text: Architecture follows a task from submission to callback. Use the CLI reference for commands and Troubleshooting for common problems. Implementation notes and validation records are collected in Engineering notes.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: Prepare Python 3.9 or later, Git, and an Agent CLI that you have signed into. Run LTC and the Agent under the same user account.

docs.title: Install the stable version
docs.text:
These commands install 0.7.0. Keep the virtual environment after installation: it holds LTC and its dependencies.

Linux / macOSWindows PowerShell 
git clone --branch v0.7.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/lz59970062/long-task-wakeup.git
cd long-task-wakeup
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install .
ltc setup --enable --now
ltc --version

git clone --branch v0.7.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/lz59970062/long-task-wakeup.git
Set-Location long-task-wakeup
py -3 -m venv .venv
& .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install .
& .\.venv\Scripts\ltc.exe setup --service windows-task --enable --now
& .\.venv\Scripts\ltc.exe --version

setup installs the Agent skills and configures the background coordinator. The last command prints the installed version. On Windows, you can continue using the full path to .venv\Scripts\ltc.exe.

docs.title: Choose your runtime
docs.text:
Environment Task owner Setup Linux desktop or server systemd user service Use the default setup macOS desktop login session launchd Run setup in the current user's terminal Windows 10 or later Task Scheduler and Job Object Keep the user logged in and use a local NTFS directory Docker, AutoDL, or Linux with screen GNU screen Follow the container steps below

In a Debian or Ubuntu container, install screen and start the coordinator:

sudo apt-get install screen
ltc setup --backend screen --service standalone --now

Place LTC, the Agent, the working directory, and the session files in the same runtime environment. Mount ~/.ltc, the Agent configuration directory, and the project directory on persistent volumes to retain task records across restarts. See the container deployment notes for images and startup configuration.

docs.title: Install the preview
docs.text:
The 0.7.1 preview includes Claude live callbacks, Pi integration, and the Desktop launcher. Install the current main branch in a new directory:

git clone https://github.com/lz59970062/long-task-wakeup.git ltc-preview
cd ltc-preview
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install .
ltc setup --force --enable --now
ltc --version

On Windows, use the PowerShell steps above and remove --branch v0.7.0 --depth 1 from the clone command.

When upgrading an existing installation, finish the queued tasks and callbacks first. Install the new version, then run ltc setup --keep-skill --force --enable --now to update the coordinator and retain your existing skill content.

Continue with Your first task.

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text: Consider the quickstart task: an Agent submits a Python command, LTC saves its execution details, runs it in the background, and returns the result to the same conversation.

docs.title: How a task runs
docs.text:
1. The Agent calls ltc run. LTC records the command, working directory, environment, and session ID, then assigns a task ID.
  2. The background coordinator, or Daemon, reads the task record and asks the execution backend to start it.
  3. A Worker runs the command and writes standard output and standard error to a log.
  4. When the command exits, the Worker saves its exit code and result and creates a callback.
  5. The Daemon delivers the callback to the original session. The Agent reads the artifacts, runs ltc ack, and decides what to do next.
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Agent session
    participant L as LTC CLI
    participant D as Daemon
    participant W as Worker
    A->>L: Submit a command
    L->>L: Save task record and session ID
    L-->>A: Return task ID and log path
    D->>W: Start task through execution backend
    W->>W: Run command, save log and result
    W-->>D: Create callback
    D-->>A: Deliver result paths and task status
    A->>L: ACK after reading the result

docs.title: Component responsibilities
docs.text:
Component Responsibility CLI Accept run, agent, and done commands; save task and callback records Daemon Coordinate startup, recovery, and callback delivery Execution backend Use operating-system process management to host Workers Worker Run the user's command; record logs, exit code, and result Agent adapter Identify sessions and construct child-agent and session-resume commands Storage Retain tasks, results, callbacks, and ACK records for inspection and recovery

Linux uses systemd user services, macOS uses launchd, and Windows uses Task Scheduler and Job Objects. Linux and macOS also offer a GNU screen backend. Each task records the selected backend at submission.

With a native backend, the coordinator and tasks have their own system service owners. After a coordinator restart, it reads existing task records, checks processes and results, and continues handling callbacks.

docs.title: Three entry points
docs.text:
ltc run starts with a command that a Worker executes. ltc agent gives instructions to a newly started Agent and saves its answer. Both share the task records, execution backends, and callback flow.

ltc done handles work already running elsewhere. For example, a Slurm job reports its exit code at the end of a script, and LTC delivers that job's result to a specified conversation.

docs.title: Finding results
docs.text:
By default, task files live in ~/.ltc/tasks/<task-id>/. attempt-1.log contains command output, and result.json records the execution result. The submission output and callback include their paths.

A callback ACK records that the Agent has received and checked the result. Use a goal plan to track a larger workflow, such as training, evaluation, and report generation.

To extend an execution backend or Agent adapter, see module responsibilities.

docs.title: Your first task
docs.text:
Run a ten-second task, receive the result in the original Agent conversation, then ask the Agent to read the log and acknowledge the callback.

These steps use LTC 0.7.0, Linux, and Codex CLI. Prepare Python 3.9 or later, Git, and a signed-in Codex CLI. Linux tasks run under systemd user services or GNU screen. See Installation for other environments.

docs.title: Install LTC
docs.text:
Run in your terminal:

git clone --branch v0.7.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/lz59970062/long-task-wakeup.git
cd long-task-wakeup
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python3 -m pip install .
ltc setup --enable --now
ltc --version

setup installs the Agent skills and starts the background coordinator. The last command should print 0.7.0.

Keep the virtual environment at this location, since the coordinator uses its Python interpreter. Start Codex CLI from the current terminal. When working in your own projects later, activate this environment before starting Codex.

docs.title: Submit your first task
docs.text:
In your Codex CLI conversation, ask Codex to execute this command. LTC reads the callback target from the session environment.

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "My first LTC task" \
  -- python3 -c "import time; time.sleep(10); print('LTC demo finished')"

--task names the task, --cwd sets its working directory, and the command follows --. LTC prints the task ID, execution backend, and log path, then returns. The Python program waits ten seconds in the background, prints one line, and exits.

docs.title: Read the result and acknowledge it
docs.text:
LTC sends the callback to the same conversation. It includes the task status, log path, and ACK command. Ask Codex to open the log. You should see:

LTC demo finished

After reading the result, ask Codex to execute the complete ACK command from the callback. For the default queue, it looks like this:

ltc ack --id <callback-id>

Replace <callback-id> with the ID in that callback. ACK records receipt and ends reminders for this callback.

To inspect pending callbacks, run:

ltc status

docs.title: Run your own task
docs.text:
Replace the sample Python command with your training command. Ask the Agent to run it in the project directory:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Train the model" \
  -- python3 train.py --config configs/exp.yaml

Choose a recognizable name, such as “Train the ResNet baseline” or “Build the Linux package.” The Agent can use that name, the log, and the output files to continue after receiving the result.

To give a code review to a child Agent, use:

ltc agent codex --cwd "$PWD" --task "Review the current changes" \
  -- "Read the current git diff. Check for issues that could cause runtime failures, and report the file locations and causes."

LTC prints the answer-file path and calls back to the original conversation when the child finishes. See Task templates to reuse these instructions.

Next, read Architecture to see how tasks and callbacks move through LTC.

docs.title: The terminal cannot find ltc
docs.text:
Activate the virtual environment where you installed LTC, then check the command:

source /path/to/long-task-wakeup/.venv/bin/activate
ltc --version

On Windows, call .venv\Scripts\ltc.exe inside the installation directory. The coordinator also uses the Python path saved during setup. Run ltc setup again after moving the environment.

docs.title: Submission reports missing session information
docs.text:
Ask the Agent to run ltc run through its current session's tool environment. When submitting from a separate terminal or job script, pass --agent and --session:

ltc run --agent codex --session "YOUR_SESSION_ID" --task "Build" -- bash scripts/build.sh

See Codex CLI and External jobs for session binding.

docs.title: The task finished, but the callback has not arrived
docs.text:
Inspect the callback queue and the session configuration:

ltc status --state pending --state running --state failed
ltc doctor --agent codex --session <session-id>

Use the report to choose the next step:

Finding Next step The coordinator has not started Run the setup command suggested in the report A Claude Code session is open Ask Claude to run the printed ltc wait command as a background Bash task The Codex Desktop connection needs setup Open the app through the Desktop launcher The callback is in failed Read the error record, fix the cause, and use ltc retry --id <callback-id> in the preview version

The original submission output contains the task's log path. Open the log and artifacts to inspect the task result directly.

docs.title: The same callback appears repeatedly
docs.text: After reading the result, run the complete ACK command from the callback. Check its ID and --queue-dir so the acknowledgement reaches the same queue.

docs.title: Resuming training after a restart
docs.text:
Find the task log, result file, and latest checkpoint. Ask the Agent to inspect the artifacts, then submit a new task using the training program's resume option:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Resume training" -- python train.py --resume outputs/checkpoint.pt

Here, --resume belongs to the example training program. Use the option and checkpoint path for your own framework.

docs.title: Reporting a problem
docs.text: Open a GitHub issue with your operating system, LTC version, submission command, error text, and relevant log excerpts. Include a small reproduction command to help locate the failing step.

docs.title: Running child agents
docs.text: Give a child Agent a task you can describe independently, such as reviewing a module, organizing experiment results, or implementing a small feature.

docs.title: Submit a code review
docs.text:
ltc agent codex --cwd "$PWD" --task "Review argument parsing" -- "Read parser.py and its tests. Check empty input, invalid arguments, and boundary cases. Report file locations, reproduction steps, and suggested fixes."

codex selects the child Agent. The text after -- describes its work. Name the files to read, the expected output, and the criteria for checking the result.

LTC prints the log path and answer-file path. When the child finishes, the callback returns to the submitting conversation. The original Agent reads the answer, checks the relevant files, and continues.

docs.title: Choose a child Agent
docs.text:
Command Worker Version ltc agent codex Codex CLI 0.7.0 ltc agent claude Claude Code CLI 0.7.0 ltc agent pi Pi 0.7.1 preview

Install and sign into the selected CLI in the submission environment. The child inherits that environment's configuration, proxy settings, and project paths.

For example, ask Claude to review code from a Codex conversation:

ltc agent claude --cwd "$PWD" --task "Review data loading" -- "Check file reading, batch assembly, and error handling in data_loader.py. Report reproducible problems."

The result returns to the submitting Codex conversation. The submitting session determines the callback target; the name after agent selects the worker.

docs.title: Define the handoff
docs.text:
End the prompt with the information you want back, for example:

List the files you changed, the test commands you ran, their results, and what needs to be checked next.

Save repeated instructions as a task template.

docs.title: Callbacks and ACK
docs.text: A callback tells the Agent which task finished, where its results are, and how to acknowledge receipt. The Agent reads the results first, then runs the included ACK command.

docs.title: Read the callback
docs.text:
Information How to use it Task name and status Identify the work and its execution state Log path Read command output and errors Answer or artifact path Open the child Agent's answer, report, or result files Details path Read the complete command and handoff instructions ACK command Record that the result has been received and checked

Callbacks use a compact format by default. Add --callback-format full when submitting to include the details directly in the callback text.

docs.title: Acknowledge receipt
docs.text:
Run the complete command provided in the callback. Its default form is:

ltc ack --id <callback-id>

For a custom queue, the printed command also includes --queue-dir. Keep it so the acknowledgement is written to that queue.

docs.title: Inspect pending callbacks
docs.text:
ltc status
ltc status --state pending --state failed

pending means a callback is waiting for delivery. For entries in failed, read the associated error record. In the 0.7.1 preview, you can retry delivery after fixing the connection:

ltc retry --id <callback-id>

This sends the saved result again. To execute another business command, submit a new task with ltc run.

docs.title: Customize the handoff
docs.text:
Edit ~/.ltc/callback-hook.md, for example:

After reading the result, tell me the artifact paths and main findings before continuing.
For experiments, include the configuration file and key metrics.

Include this text with every callback:

ltc prompt-policy --user-every 1

Run ltc prompt-policy to inspect the current intervals. See Configuration for file paths and environment variables.

docs.title: External jobs
docs.text: For work already started by Slurm, tmux, or another runtime, call ltc done at the end to deliver the result to an Agent conversation.

docs.title: Report a completed run
docs.text:
This command creates a callback from the original Agent session:

ltc done --cwd "$PWD" --task "Build the data index" --exit-code 0 --message "The index is saved in outputs/index.json"

Pass the actual exit code in --exit-code and the artifact location or handoff instructions in --message. The receiving Agent can then open the file and continue using the result.

docs.title: Add it to a job script
docs.text:
Insert the original session ID in your script. Save the business command's exit code before reporting the result to LTC. For Bash:

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set +e
python train.py --config configs/exp.yaml
job_exit=$?
ltc done --agent codex --session "YOUR_SESSION_ID" --cwd "$PWD" \
  --task "Slurm training" --exit-code "$job_exit" \
  --message "Logs and checkpoints are saved in outputs/exp/"
exit "$job_exit"

Read CODEX_THREAD_ID in the originating Codex tool environment to obtain the session ID. Claude Code uses CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID. Save that value in the submitted script to identify the receiving conversation.

For Slurm, LTC, the coordinator, and the receiving Agent need access to the same queue and session files. With a shared directory, pass the same --queue-dir to setup, done, and ack.

docs.title: Set up a callback service
docs.text:
To configure a machine for reporting external jobs, use:

ltc setup --callback-only --enable --now

See Callbacks and ACK for handling the result.

docs.title: Multi-stage goals
docs.text: Use a Goal to track a sequence of work, such as training a model, evaluating it, and generating a report.

docs.title: Create a plan
docs.text:
Create goal-plan.yaml in the project:

version: 1
revision: 1
goal: Complete the baseline experiment report
path:
  - id: train
    title: Train the baseline model
    status: in_progress
  - id: evaluate
    title: Evaluate the model and collect metrics
    status: pending
  - id: report
    title: Generate the experiment report
    status: pending

Step statuses are pending, in_progress, blocked, and completed. Keep the list in execution order. After finishing one step, mark the next one in_progress.

docs.title: Bind the goal to a session
docs.text:
Ask Codex to execute this in the current session's tool environment:

ltc goal start --id baseline-report --agent codex --session "$CODEX_THREAD_ID" \
  --cwd "$PWD" --task "Complete the baseline report" --plan-file goal-plan.yaml

Attach the goal ID when submitting related tasks:

ltc run --goal-id baseline-report --cwd "$PWD" --task "Train the baseline" -- python train.py

When the task finishes, the Agent reads the result, acknowledges the callback, and updates the plan. By default, an active goal sends a progress check every three hours to help the original conversation continue the current step.

docs.title: Complete the goal
docs.text:
Once the artifacts have been checked, mark every plan step completed and run:

ltc goal check --id baseline-report

Copy the plan digest from the output and confirm completion:

ltc goal ack --id baseline-report --state completed --plan-sha256 <plan-digest>

If the work is waiting for data or another external condition, record that condition:

ltc goal ack --id baseline-report --state blocked_conditions --condition "Waiting for the dataset download"

Run ltc goal resume --id baseline-report when it is ready to continue. When the plan changes, update revision and record the reason in the file.

docs.title: Running commands
docs.text: Use ltc run for training, builds, tests, or data processing. Ask the Agent to execute it in the current conversation so LTC can record the callback target.

docs.title: Submit a task
docs.text:
ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Train the ResNet baseline" -- python train.py --config configs/resnet.yaml

--cwd sets the working directory. Relative paths for configuration, input data, and output directories start there. Choose a recognizable --task name to identify the run when its callback arrives.

LTC treats everything after -- as the program and its arguments. The task inherits the submission environment, so activate the required environment first:

source .venv/bin/activate
ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Run the tests" -- python -m pytest tests/

docs.title: Read the log
docs.text:
The submission output includes a task log path. Open that file in an editor, or read its latest lines in a terminal:

tail -n 60 /path/to/task/attempt-1.log

The callback includes the same path. Ask the Agent to inspect the exit code, log, and project artifacts, such as the test summary or a training checkpoint.

docs.title: Run a script
docs.text:
For a longer command sequence, put the steps in a script:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Build the package" -- bash scripts/build.sh

For shell pipelines or redirection, invoke the shell explicitly:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Generate the report" -- bash -lc 'python analyse.py && python report.py'

On Windows, you can use powershell.exe -File scripts/build.ps1 as the task command.

docs.title: Choose an execution backend
docs.text:
The default --backend auto selects a backend for the operating system. On a server or container using GNU screen, choose it explicitly:

ltc run --backend screen --cwd "$PWD" --task "Train the model" -- python train.py

See Installation for backend setup and Callbacks and ACK for handling completed work.

docs.title: Task templates
docs.text: Save recurring task instructions in YAML. Each submission can then add the files and goals for that particular run.

docs.title: Write a review template
docs.text:
Create review.yaml in your project:

version: 1
prompt: |
  Read the supplied requirements and code. Check for issues that affect runtime behavior.
  For each issue, give the file location, trigger, expected behavior, and actual behavior.
  Deliver a review report.
handoff: |
  Check each finding, confirm the issue, then arrange the changes and tests.

prompt gives instructions to the child Agent. handoff describes what to do when the result returns to the original conversation.

docs.title: Use the template
docs.text:
Preview the expanded prompt first:

ltc agent codex --template-file ./review.yaml --dry-run -- "Review parser.py and tests/test_parser.py."

After checking the output, submit the task:

ltc agent codex --template-file ./review.yaml --cwd "$PWD" --task "Parser review" -- "Review parser.py and tests/test_parser.py."

The text after -- is appended to the template prompt. LTC saves the expanded instructions at submission so you can inspect what the child received.

docs.title: Reuse it across projects
docs.text:
Save the file as ~/.config/ltc/templates/review.yaml to call it by name:

ltc agent codex --template review --task "Review current changes" -- "Read the current git diff and check behavior changes."

docs.title: Register an Agent skill
docs.text:
The 0.7.1 preview can register a template as a discoverable Agent skill:

ltc template register review --file ./review.yaml --worker codex --description "Review code and report reproducible issues"
ltc template list

After registration, Codex can invoke $ltc-review, and Claude Code can invoke /ltc-review. See the template registration notes for fields, file locations, and updates.

docs.title: Use cases
docs.text: Choose who will do the work: use ltc run for a program, ltc agent for an independent analysis or development task, and ltc done for work already running in a scheduler. Run the commands below from an Agent session configured with LTC, replacing file paths with those in your project.

docs.title: Evaluate a model after training
docs.text:
You are developing a model and want the Agent to read metrics, check the checkpoint, and arrange evaluation once training finishes.

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Train the baseline" -- python train.py --config configs/baseline.yaml

Before submission, tell the Agent:

When training finishes, read the log and record the final metrics and checkpoint path. Check the artifacts, ACK the callback, then evaluate that checkpoint and write the results to reports/baseline.md.

The training program saves the checkpoint. The Agent uses the exit code and log to decide whether to start evaluation or address a training error. Use Multi-stage goals to keep a record of each stage.

docs.title: Handle test or build failures
docs.text:
Submit a long test suite as a background task:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Full test suite" -- python -m pytest tests/ --junitxml=reports/tests.xml

After receiving the result, the Agent opens the log and reports/tests.xml, identifies failed cases, and runs relevant tests after making changes. For a build, use bash scripts/build.sh and name the package paths to inspect in your handoff instructions.

docs.title: Ask another Agent to review code
docs.text:
From Codex, ask Claude to review a module:

ltc agent claude --cwd "$PWD" --task "Review data loading" -- "Read data_loader.py and its tests. Check missing files, empty data, and batch boundaries. Report locations, reproduction steps, and suggested fixes."

Claude's answer is saved in the task directory, and the result returns to the originating Codex conversation. Codex reads the report, checks the findings, and arranges changes. Save recurring review instructions in a task template.

docs.title: Receive results from Slurm or tmux
docs.text:
For a job already running on a cluster or in tmux, report at the end of its script:

ltc done --agent codex --session "YOUR_SESSION_ID" --task "Cluster training finished" \
  --exit-code "$job_exit" --message "Results are in /shared/experiments/baseline/"

Save job_exit=$? immediately after the business command exits. The submission host, reporting host, and coordinator use the same queue directory, and the receiving Agent needs access to the result path. See External jobs for a complete script.

docs.title: Check data-processing outputs
docs.text:
ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Build a retrieval index" -- python build_index.py --output outputs/index

Specify checks in the handoff, such as comparing input and output counts, sampling ten records, and running a retrieval query. The Agent checks the artifacts when the callback arrives, then writes a short data-quality report.

docs.title: Run a custom Agent workflow
docs.text:
If your project exposes its Agent workflow through a Python entry point, submit that entry point as a command:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Analyze a document collection" -- python workflows/analyse_documents.py

Have the script save its report and intermediate artifacts. Results return to the submitting Codex, Claude, or Pi conversation. To make the custom harness itself receive callbacks, implement a session adapter as described in Harness support.

docs.title: Choose a callback route
docs.text:
Current environment Recommended workflow Codex CLI Submit in the current conversation; the coordinator resumes that session Claude Code CLI or desktop Code session Run the printed ltc wait command as a background Bash task Pi Install the extension for live callbacks; launch through ltc pi for recovery after closing Codex Desktop Use the preview shared Core launcher, then check delivery with a small task

See Harness support for versions and validation records.

docs.title: Claude Code
docs.text: Live callback delivery uses the 0.7.1 preview. Follow preview installation, then run ltc setup to install the LTC skill for Claude Code.

docs.title: Submit a task and receive the result
docs.text:
Ask Claude to submit this in the current conversation:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Run the tests" -- python -m pytest tests/

The submission output provides an ltc wait command, for example:

ltc wait --queue-dir ~/.ltc/queue --task <task-id>

Ask Claude to execute the complete printed command through its Bash tool with run_in_background: true. When the result enters the queue, ltc wait prints the callback and exits. Claude Code then handles the background command's completion message.

After reading the logs and artifacts, Claude runs the callback's ltc ack command. This workflow works in the terminal CLI and local Code sessions in the Claude desktop app.

docs.title: Describe the work in plain language
docs.text:
After installing the skill, you can say:

Run the full test suite through LTC. When the results arrive, read the failed-test logs, identify the causes, and suggest fixes.

The skill guides Claude through submission, the background waiter, reading results, and acknowledgement.

docs.title: Configure the CLI
docs.text:
To start Claude child Agents or resume a closed conversation through the CLI, sign into the CLI on this machine:

claude auth login
claude auth status

Check LTC from the current session's tool environment:

ltc doctor --agent claude --session "$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID"

For SSH work, install LTC and its skill on the remote host where the task runs. See the Claude Code implementation notes for executable discovery, session directories, and the channel integration.

docs.title: Codex CLI
docs.text: Follow Installation, then activate LTC's virtual environment in the terminal where you start Codex.

docs.title: Submit from a conversation
docs.text:
Ask Codex to run:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Build the project" -- bash scripts/build.sh

LTC reads CODEX_THREAD_ID from the tool environment and binds the task to the current session. When it finishes, the coordinator resumes that session and delivers the result.

For everyday use, you can tell Codex:

Run this build through LTC. When it finishes, read the log, check the output package, and tell me the result.

The skill installed by ltc setup covers submission, callback handling, and ACK.

docs.title: Specify the receiving session
docs.text:
When submitting from another script, pass the session ID explicitly:

ltc run --agent codex --session "YOUR_SESSION_ID" --cwd "$PWD" --task "Build the project" -- bash scripts/build.sh

Use the original session's CODEX_HOME so LTC can find the same session records and configuration. The default configuration directory is ~/.codex.

docs.title: Check the configuration
docs.text:
Run this in the Codex tool environment:

ltc doctor --agent codex --session "$CODEX_THREAD_ID"

Follow the suggested fixes for the installation, coordinator, or session configuration. Then run the ten-second example to check callback delivery.

For the desktop app, see Codex Desktop.

docs.title: Codex Desktop
docs.text: Codex Desktop integration uses the shared Core launcher in the 0.7.1 preview. Desktop and LTC access sessions through the same Core, which delivers callbacks into the desktop app when tasks finish.

docs.title: Generate a launcher
docs.text:
Install the preview on macOS or Windows, then run:

ltc setup --force --enable --now
ltc desktop status

macOS generates Start LTC Desktop.command. Windows generates Start LTC Desktop.cmd and a PowerShell script. The default location is the long-task-wakeup folder inside your Codex configuration directory.

docs.title: Start Desktop
docs.text:
Save your work and quit Desktop. Double-click the generated launcher, or run:

ltc desktop launch

Submit a small task from that Desktop session:

ltc run --callback-mode desktop --cwd "$PWD" --task "Desktop callback example" -- python -c "print('Desktop callback ready')"

Ask the Agent to read the result and run the included ACK command to check the integration. In a PowerShell tool environment, use --cwd "$($PWD.Path)" in place of --cwd "$PWD".

docs.title: Choose an app path
docs.text:
On macOS with multiple app installations, select one explicitly:

ltc desktop prepare --app /Applications/Codex.app --force

Windows uses direct launch by default. The experimental Store package-context option is configured with:

ltc setup --desktop-launch-mode package-context --force --enable --now

See the macOS Desktop and Windows Desktop notes for platform setup and validation records. After an app upgrade, run the small example again to check callbacks.

docs.title: Pi
docs.text: Pi integration uses the 0.7.1 preview. Pi can receive results for its own tasks and work as a child Agent on independent assignments.

docs.title: Install the extension
docs.text:
Follow preview installation, then run:

ltc setup --with-pi-extension --enable --now

Run /reload in an existing ordinary Pi session, or restart Pi. The extension and skill are installed in the Pi configuration directory, which defaults to ~/.pi/agent.

docs.title: Submit from Pi
docs.text:
Ask Pi to run:

ltc run --cwd "$PWD" --task "Prepare the data" -- python prepare_data.py

LTC binds the task to the session named by PI_SESSION_FILE. When the result arrives, the extension delivers the callback into that Pi process. An idle Pi starts handling it immediately; a busy Pi receives it after the current tool work finishes.

After reading the artifacts, ask Pi to execute the callback's ACK command.

docs.title: Launch Pi through LTC
docs.text:
To allow session recovery after Pi closes, start a managed session:

ltc pi --cwd "$PWD"

To continue an existing session, provide its absolute path:

ltc pi --session /absolute/path/to/session.jsonl

docs.title: Give work to Pi
docs.text:
Submit from the original Agent conversation:

ltc agent pi --cwd "$PWD" --task "Review data preparation" -- "Read prepare_data.py. Check missing values, duplicate records, and output formats. Report specific issues."

The answer is saved in the LTC task directory. Its path appears in both the submission output and callback. See the Pi implementation notes for model options, system prompts, and session recovery.

docs.title: Harness support
docs.text:
A harness is the program around an Agent: it manages conversations, calls models, runs tools, and delivers new messages. LTC integration covers starting the harness as a child Agent and returning task results to its original conversation.

This page reflects the current main implementation and repository validation records, checked on 2026-10-12. The quickstart uses stable 0.7.0; newer integrations use the 0.7.1 preview.

docs.title: Native integrations
docs.text:
Harness / client Child Agent Results in the original conversation Version and validation Codex CLI ltc agent codex Bind through CODEX_THREAD_ID and resume through the CLI 0.7.0; see the release and platform records below Claude Code CLI ltc agent claude Background ltc wait for live delivery; standalone CLI for session resume Child and CLI resume support from 0.7.0; live delivery in the 0.7.1 preview, verified on Linux/macOS Claude desktop app, Code sessions Child tasks use a signed-in standalone Claude CLI Run ltc wait through background Bash 0.7.1 preview; verified with macOS local sessions and Linux SSH sessions Pi ltc agent pi Extension sends a steer message to the live process; ltc pi adds recovery after closing 0.7.1 preview; recorded validation on Linux with Pi 0.87.1; macOS/Windows validation pending Codex Desktop Child tasks use Codex CLI Shared Core launcher with --callback-mode desktop 0.7.1 preview; real Desktop restart, receipt, and ACK acceptance for the new installation path is pending

You can combine child and receiving Agents. For example, ltc agent claude in Codex runs the task with Claude and returns the result to Codex. Follow the Codex, Claude, Pi, or Desktop guide.

Claude also has an ltc claude channel research preview. The repository records live receipt and ACK on Linux with Claude Code 2.1.296. See the channel setup.

docs.title: Other harnesses and orchestration frameworks
docs.text:
Name Current integration route Work for native integration Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Aider, Goose Run a configured command-line task through ltc run -- <command> and return results to an existing receiver Implement child arguments, session detection, and callback transport; validate each end to end LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, custom Agent SDK programs Save the workflow in a script and use ltc run, or call ltc done at the end of an existing job Implement a session adapter and wakeup channel for the receiving harness DSH An adapter is on the repository roadmap Complete implementation and validation, then add it to the native table

These frameworks currently use the generic command interface. The native adapter registry contains codex, claude, and pi. Begin with a script that prints a result and exits, check the log, callback, and ACK, then connect the actual workflow. See the custom workflow example.

docs.title: Execution environments
docs.text:
Environment Task backend Setup conditions Linux systemd user services, GNU screen Desktop or server; screen is useful in containers and SSH environments macOS launchd, GNU screen launchd uses the logged-in user's GUI session Windows 10+ Task Scheduler, Job Object Keep the user logged in; use local NTFS storage for task state

These task backends ship in 0.7.0. Configure the callback route for your chosen harness using the native integration table. Windows validation for Claude live callbacks is pending.

docs.title: Add a harness
docs.text:
Start with agents/base.py and agents/registry.py:

  1. Implement child startup: locate the executable, build its command, pass the prompt, and choose file or standard-output result capture.
  2. Define session binding: read the session identifier and retain the profile and directory needed for recovery.
  3. Add delivery: construct a resume command for a closed session and a message channel for a running session.
  4. Register the adapter and add CLI selection, installation entry points, and a usage skill for that harness.
  5. Use an isolated session to validate submission, logs, results, receipt, and ACK. Check busy-session, exit, and retry behavior.

ChildAgentAdapter describes the child-task interface. AgentAdapter adds session detection and resume. Organizing the implementation around these interfaces lets you validate execution and delivery separately.

docs.title: CLI reference
docs.text:
Inspect the complete options with:

ltc --help
ltc run --help
ltc agent --help

docs.title: Install and inspect
docs.text: Command Purpose ltc --version Print the current version ltc setup --enable --now Install skills and start the coordinator ltc setup --keep-skill --force --enable --now Update the coordinator and retain skill content ltc doctor --agent codex --session <id> Inspect a session's runtime configuration

docs.title: Submit work
docs.text:
Command Purpose ltc run --task <name> -- <command> Submit a command ltc agent codex -- <prompt> Start a Codex child Agent ltc agent claude -- <prompt> Start a Claude child Agent ltc done --task <name> --exit-code <code> Report an external task result

Put submission options before --:

Option Purpose --cwd <directory> Working directory --task <name> Task name shown in the callback --agent <type> Agent type receiving the callback --session <session> Session receiving the callback --queue-dir <directory> Callback queue location --backend auto Select the task execution backend automatically --goal-id <goal> Associate the task with a multi-stage goal --callback-format full Use the full callback text

docs.title: Handle callbacks
docs.text: Command Purpose ltc status Inspect outstanding callbacks ltc status --state failed Inspect failed deliveries ltc ack --id <callback-id> Confirm that you have read the result ltc cancel --id <callback-id> Cancel delivery of this callback ltc prompt-policy Inspect reminder intervals

docs.title: Preview commands
docs.text:
These commands use the 0.7.1 preview:

Command Purpose ltc wait --task <task-id> Wait for and print a callback in Claude Code ltc retry --id <callback-id> Redeliver a saved callback ltc agent pi -- <prompt> Start a Pi child Agent ltc pi Open an LTC-managed Pi session ltc template list List registered templates ltc desktop status Inspect Desktop connection settings ltc desktop launch Start Desktop through the shared Core

See Multi-stage goals for the goal command sequence.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: LTC saves task commands, logs, execution results, and callback records. These files let you inspect earlier runs when troubleshooting or continuing work.

docs.title: Default locations
docs.text:
Location Contents ~/.ltc/tasks/<task-id>/task.json Command, working directory, backend, and session binding ~/.ltc/tasks/<task-id>/attempt-1.log Output from the first execution attempt ~/.ltc/tasks/<task-id>/result.json Exit code and execution result ~/.ltc/queue/ Callbacks and their delivery states ~/.ltc/callback-hook.md User-supplied callback instructions ~/.ltc/callback-prompts.yaml Callback reminder intervals ~/.config/ltc/templates/ Reusable task templates

The child Agent's answer path and callback details path appear in the submission output or callback. Open the files at those paths.

docs.title: Environment variables
docs.text:
Variable Purpose LTC_HOME LTC state directory; defaults to ~/.ltc CODEX_HOME Codex configuration and sessions; defaults to ~/.codex CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR Claude Code configuration; defaults to ~/.claude PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR Pi configuration; defaults to ~/.pi/agent LTC_TEMPLATE_DIR Custom template directory

~ means the current user's home directory, or the user profile directory on Windows.

docs.title: Use a custom queue
docs.text:
Choose an absolute path and use the same directory for setup, submission, and acknowledgement:

ltc setup --queue-dir /absolute/path/to/ltc-queue --enable --now
ltc run --queue-dir /absolute/path/to/ltc-queue --task "Tests" -- python -m pytest
ltc status --queue-dir /absolute/path/to/ltc-queue

Finish the work in the old queue before changing an existing coordinator's queue. To run multiple LTC installations, give each one a separate Agent profile and queue.

docs.title: Edit callback instructions
docs.text:
Write your preferred result-handling instructions in callback-hook.md. LTC reads the current file content when a reminder is due. Set the intervals with:

ltc prompt-policy --system-every 4 --user-every 3

The two numbers control the system and user prompt intervals. Set an interval to 1 to attach that prompt to every callback.

docs.title: Contributing to the docs
docs.text: Documentation and code live in the same repository. Edit the relevant Markdown file and build the site to preview your changes.

docs.title: Preview locally
docs.text:
Run from the repository root:

python3 -m venv .venv-docs
source .venv-docs/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs serve

Open the local address printed in the terminal. The page refreshes when you edit a file.

docs.title: Add a tutorial
docs.text:
Directory Content docs/guides/ Steps for completing a specific task docs/integrations/ Agent setup and usage docs/reference/ Options, configuration, and engineering references

Use topic.md for Chinese and topic.en.md in the same directory for English. Add the base filename to nav in mkdocs.yml, then add its English title to nav_translations. Use the base filename in links in both languages, such as ../installation.md. The build resolves each link to the matching language.

Link to the new page from related tutorials. Chinese keeps the site's root paths; English uses /en/. The language menu at the top opens the other-language version of the current page.

A tutorial starts with what the reader wants to do, gives runnable commands, and explains the expected output and next step. Express parameter requirements as concrete setup instructions and give repair steps for common problems.

docs.title: Check and publish
docs.text:
Before submitting, run:

python scripts/docs_sync.py check
mkdocs build --strict
python scripts/docs_sync.py export

The build checks configuration and documentation links. Changes merged into main are built and published to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions.

The coverage check requires Chinese and English versions of every page in the navigation. The export command generates GitBook Markdown, tables of contents, and configuration for both languages. See Publishing and synchronization for initial platform setup and automatic updates.

docs.text: All tutorials are maintained in docs/ in the GitHub repository. Chinese files use .md; English files use .en.md. Each update to main checks translation coverage, builds the site, and updates the GitBook export branches.
